title: SciPy Statistical Significance Tests and Interpreting Results
learningObjectives: Explain the purpose of scipy statistical significance tests and interpreting results.
Select the relevant SciPy subpackage and API.
Apply the method to a small reproducible dataset.
Inspect and validate returned values and metadata.
Explain assumptions, edge cases and limitations.

understand.concept: SciPy's scipy.stats subpackage provides hypothesis tests and descriptive statistical tools. Tests return statistics and p-values, which must be interpreted in the context of a null hypothesis, sampling design and assumptions. A p-value is not the probability that the null hypothesis is true, and statistical significance does not establish practical importance or causation.
understand.whyItMatters: SciPy provides established algorithms for scientific analysis, engineering, research and data-processing workflows.
understand.analogy: A scientific method is a specialized tool: it is useful when its assumptions match the task, but it cannot replace careful measurement or interpretation.

examples.title: Pearson correlation test
examples.code:

r=pearsonr([1,2,3],[2,4,6])
print(round(r.statistic,3))
